cut: In src/commands.rs, keep the validated Secret returned by secret::merge and fill its single value or requested fields from the submission, deleting the reverse walk over placeholder fields and the second merge. In src/link/endpoint.rs and src/serve.rs, have listen_address take a binding callback and return the selected listener, preserving IPv4 preference and refusals while removing the two intermediate vectors and address lookup. In src/serve.rs, keep the buffered body prefix and use Read::read_exact for the remainder within the existing body limit. In src/secret.rs, combine the two match arms that clone a single value.
answer: Made all four cuts: put_secret keeps merge's Secret and fills its values from the submission (no second merge, no reverse walk); listen_address takes a bind callback and returns the listener, IPv4 first, refusals kept; read_request reads the body's rest with read_exact under BODY_MAX; secret.rs's two single-value arms are one. The rest is the server, its tests and help the issue asks for.
